description.en: Unlocks a tactical formation, by formation ID, optionally selecting it and/or marking it as new.
ID of the formation to unlock, e.g. "ifa0001".
Optional; whether to select this formation as active.
Optional; whether to flag the formation as newly unlocked.
True once the call has taken effect (including as a no-op if the formation system isn't ready yet); null if the call was invalid (no ID given).
